symptom: Engine runs rough or is unstable.
related_information: If any failure code is displayed, perform troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.point_to_check: If fuel tank is checked, it is empty.

steps.cause: Clogging fuel tank cap air bleeding hole
steps.point_to_check: Fuel tank cap air bleeding hole is clogged.
steps.remedy: Flush air breather hole in fuel tank cap surrounding area.

steps.point_to_check: Check used hours of fuel filter element. If it is used over specified time, fuel filter element may be clogged.

steps.cause: Foreign materials are mixed into fuel.
steps.point_to_check: If drain fuel from fuel tank, rust or water comes out.

steps.cause: Air mixed in fuel piping system
steps.point_to_check: When performing bleeding air from the fuel system, air comes out. (For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Bleed Air from Fuel System”).
steps.remedy: • Perform air bleeding operation • Correct or replace fuel piping

steps.point_to_check: Fuel leaks from fuel piping. (For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine Fuel Circuit for Leakage”).
steps.remedy: Correct or replace fuel piping related parts

steps.cause: Fuel leakage at Injector and inlet connector
steps.point_to_check: Return rate from injector is high. (See Testing and Adjusting, “How to Examine Fuel Discharge, Return, and Leakage”)
Check boost system (between turbocharger outlet and aftercooler, aftercooler and between aftercooler and air intake manifold) for leakage.
